name: Gozzano (Italy)
description: Square flag with a yellow border enclosing a vertical tricolour of green, white and red, the white charged with the crowned municipal arms of Gozzano.
history: Municipal flag of Gozzano, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Gozzano arms — red shield with a white bar, crowned, within branches
